title: The influence of chronic ecdysterone application in postmenopausal women on metabolism and muscle growth during a 12-week training intervention
summary: It is known from previous studies that ecdysterone in combination with exercise stimulates the growth and functionality of skeletal muscle mass in humans. The question therefore arises as to whether the body composition of menopausal and postmenopausal women can be positively influenced by this. The study also investigates whether the hormonal balance of postmenopausal women can be influenced. This will investigate whether complaints associated with the menopause can be reduced or even prevented.
conditions: Sarcopenia, decrease in performance, hormonal imbalance

interventions.name: training: Over a period of 12 weeks, test subjects will participate in a supervised full-body strength training three times per week. Following this, there will be a 12-week wash-out phase. Each participant will complete two arms of the study.

Training and ecdysterone: Over a period of 12 weeks, test subjects will participate in a supervised full-body strength training three times per week. Following this, there will be a 12-week wash-out phase. Additionally, they take an spinach extract twice a day, with a dosage of 5g each time. The ext

Ecdysterone: Ecdysterone is administered as a spinach extract (5g twice a day) for 12 weeks in the form of a powder. It can be taken with liquid or yoghurt, as desired. The wash-out phase lasts 12 weeks, and each test person goes through two arms.
control group: no intervention. Each participant will complete two arms of the study.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
18 months after the menopause
Exclusion criteria:
Intake of hormone supplements, permanent neurological or oncological or cardiovascular diseases
